_note: Release files written by `python -m ldpt.models.l_dpt.convert` from the training checkpoints of configs/hybrid/ (docs/training.md), pinned to a commit of the model repo. The default is the first recommended entry; with one entry the UI shows no model choice. LDPT_CKPT_<NAME> (the id without 'l-dpt_', upper-cased, '-' -> '_': LDPT_CKPT_LARGE_DEPTH_ZEROSHOT, the variable of the API) replaces a source by a local release file. 'expect' pins release-config values checked before loading; 'sha256' is checked after a download.

models.label: L-DPT Large (zero-shot)
models.description: L-DPT Large (zero-shot): trained on 8 synthetic and multi-view sets only, with no image of the NYUv2, KITTI, DIODE or ETH3D benchmarks. The model for photos, and the model of the demo examples and of the README figures.
